query: In which city is the Taj Mahal?
answer: The Taj Mahal is in Agra, a city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It stands on the south bank of the Yamuna River [1]. The Mughal emperor Shah Jahan had it built as a mausoleum for his wife, Mumtaz Mahal. Many of the search results were low-quality pages, so this answer relies on a mirror of the Wikipedia article.
